maturity_rule: Registration institutionalizes identity and responsibility only. No member is promoted beyond evidence-backed maturity.

systems.purpose: Build, package, version and maintain software assets, adapters, plugins, provider bindings and integration components.
systems.human_surface: Build queue, artifacts, adapters, package state and maintenance views
systems.authority_boundary: Build capability does not grant production deployment, provider-write or release authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve requested asset and dependencies.
five_stage.govern: Apply build, IP and security policy.
five_stage.verify: Run deterministic build and package checks.
five_stage.preserve: Retain source/artifact/version lineage.

systems.purpose: Certify provider adapters, plugins, integrations and execution paths using governed tests and evidence before production eligibility.
systems.human_surface: Certification queue, evidence, test matrix and disposition views
systems.authority_boundary: Certification evaluates a defined capability; it does not create provider credentials or business authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve candidate adapter/path and test obligations.
five_stage.govern: Apply certification standard and independence rules.
five_stage.preserve: Retain certificate scope, evidence and expiry/version state.

systems.purpose: Version, package, publish and reconcile governed CrownThrive software releases and release evidence.
systems.human_surface: Release queue, manifests, packages, notes, rollback and evidence views
systems.authority_boundary: Release preparation does not bypass required merge, certification, provider, security or human gates.

five_stage.discover: Resolve releasable deltas and target versions.
five_stage.govern: Apply release and promotion policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain manifests, notes, hashes and rollback lineage.

systems.purpose: Govern merge readiness, stacking, dependency order, conflict disposition and exact-head promotion into canonical branches.
systems.human_surface: Merge queue, collision state, dependency stack and disposition views
systems.authority_boundary: Merge mechanics do not manufacture approval, quorum, review or release authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve open deltas, dependencies and collisions.
five_stage.govern: Apply exact-head, review and merge policy.
five_stage.verify: Read back canonical branch and checks.
five_stage.preserve: Retain merge receipts and supersession lineage.

systems.purpose: Follow delivery work, identify unresolved gaps and stale work, and drive bounded closure, restacking, preservation or retirement dispositions.
systems.human_surface: Gap queue, SLA/TTL state, closure receipts and exception views
systems.authority_boundary: May propose or execute only closure actions already permitted by applicable source/governance policy.

five_stage.discover: Find unresolved gaps and expired work.
five_stage.govern: Classify legitimate hold versus actionable closure.
five_stage.preserve: Retain closure rationale and evidence.

systems.purpose: Manage provider credential references, lifecycle/readiness, binding and credential health without exposing secret material.
systems.human_surface: Credential inventory metadata, binding readiness, expiry and health views
systems.authority_boundary: Credential possession or health never equals permission to use it; secret material remains protected outside public registries.

five_stage.discover: Resolve credential references and binding state.
five_stage.govern: Apply scope, owner, environment and access policy.
five_stage.execute: Bind/rotate/revoke only through authorized secret-management paths.
five_stage.verify: Check health without exposing secret material.
five_stage.preserve: Retain non-secret lifecycle and audit receipts.

systems.purpose: Continuously nurse and maintain registered software, integrations, dependencies, health signals, sessions and lifecycle obligations.
systems.human_surface: Maintenance queue, health, dependency aging, cookie/session policy and remediation views
systems.authority_boundary: Maintenance may restore intended operation only within pre-authorized bounds; it cannot silently expand functionality or access.

five_stage.discover: Sense health, aging and maintenance needs.
five_stage.govern: Apply maintenance windows and authority.
five_stage.verify: Read back system health and regressions.
five_stage.preserve: Retain maintenance history and learned failure patterns.

systems.purpose: Govern Commerce & Economic Activation optimization across authorized CrownThrive economic rails while preserving constitutional limits.
systems.human_surface: Economic activation, commerce opportunity, value-routing and control views
systems.authority_boundary: May optimize within authority and may never manufacture authority, money-movement permission, pricing approval or entitlement.

five_stage.discover: Resolve authorized economic opportunities and constraints.
five_stage.govern: Apply CHLOM economic/spend/rights boundaries.
five_stage.preserve: Retain economic decisions, receipts and attribution.

systems.purpose: Govern credits and internal economic-value representations, balances, issuance constraints, attribution and lifecycle state.
systems.human_surface: Credits ledger, policy, grant, burn/expiry and reconciliation views
systems.authority_boundary: Credits operations require explicit economic authority and do not create cash, securities, ownership or external legal tender status.

five_stage.discover: Resolve credit state and obligations.
five_stage.govern: Apply issuance/use/expiry authority.
five_stage.preserve: Retain ledger/event evidence.

systems.purpose: Govern institutional email composition, routing, provider bindings, delivery state, threading, templates, receipts and retention.
systems.human_surface: Mail portal with inbox/outbox queues, templates, delivery status, policies and evidence
systems.authority_boundary: May send only from authorized identities to authorized recipients for authorized purposes; messaging does not manufacture business authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve recipient, thread, template and provider state.
five_stage.govern: Apply identity, content, consent and communication policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain governed message and delivery lineage.

systems.purpose: Coordinate bounded concierge requests, research, bookings, calls, follow-ups, service fulfillment and customer/operator handoffs.
systems.human_surface: Concierge request portal, queues, confirmations, provider state and service history
systems.authority_boundary: May act only within explicit request, spend, identity, provider and human-confirmation boundaries.

five_stage.discover: Resolve service request and available providers.
five_stage.govern: Apply consent, spend and confirmation policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain request, confirmation and fulfillment evidence.

systems.purpose: Produce owner-facing self-status reports for PENTA systems, jobs, providers, incidents, health, maturity, holds and evidence gaps.
systems.human_surface: Per-system status portal, owner reports, health summaries, incident and maturity views
systems.authority_boundary: Status reports describe evidence-backed state and never manufacture success, production, authority or remediation permission.

five_stage.discover: Collect bounded system evidence and health state.
five_stage.govern: Classify audience/sensitivity and truth confidence.
five_stage.preserve: Retain snapshots and trend history.

systems.purpose: Manage agents/workers, assign bounded work, maintain role contracts, capacity, performance obligations and escalation paths.
systems.human_surface: Manager portal for workers, contracts, queues, capacity, goals and escalations
systems.authority_boundary: Managers can assign only work within valid role/contract and delegated authority; they cannot create their own superior authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve workers, contracts and workload.
five_stage.govern: Apply role, delegation and capacity policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain assignments, reviews and contract lineage.

systems.purpose: Supervise managers and workers and issue governed policies, SOPs, SLAs, service standards and operating directives within delegated scope.
systems.human_surface: Director portal for policies, SOPs, SLAs, supervision and exception decisions
systems.authority_boundary: Directors may govern within chartered scope but cannot override CHLOM, board, legal, security or human-reserved authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve supervised portfolio and policy gaps.
five_stage.govern: Issue bounded operating policy.
five_stage.preserve: Version policies, SOPs and supervisory evidence.

systems.purpose: Organize governed worker/agent cohorts, shared missions, lifecycle stages, learning groups and bounded collaborative assignments.
systems.human_surface: Cohort roster, mission, progress, membership and outcome views
systems.authority_boundary: Cohort membership never creates authority beyond each member's contract and delegated scope.

five_stage.discover: Resolve cohort purpose and eligible members.
five_stage.govern: Apply membership and mission policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain cohort lineage and learning.

systems.purpose: Accelerate governed agents, cohorts and capabilities through staged learning, testing, mentorship, readiness and bounded promotion pathways.
systems.human_surface: Acceleration stages, curriculum, readiness, mentors and graduation evidence
systems.authority_boundary: Acceleration may improve readiness but certification/promotion requires the designated independent gates.

five_stage.discover: Resolve capability gaps and target stage.
five_stage.govern: Apply curriculum/readiness policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain progress and learning lineage.

systems.purpose: Capture agentic/human feedback, observations, voting inputs, ramifications, lessons, breakdowns, luck factors and structured retrospectives.
systems.human_surface: Feedback, note, vote-input, retrospective and lessons portal
systems.authority_boundary: Notes and votes are inputs unless a governing charter explicitly makes a specific vote binding.

five_stage.discover: Capture observations and feedback.
five_stage.govern: Classify sensitivity, provenance and decision weight.
five_stage.preserve: Retain institutional learning and feedback history.

systems.purpose: Triage incidents, requests, failures, alerts and worker/system needs by severity, ownership, urgency, route and required authority.
systems.human_surface: Triage queue, severity, owner, SLA and escalation views
systems.authority_boundary: Triage determines disposition and routing, not permission to perform consequential remediation.

five_stage.discover: Collect incident/request context.
five_stage.govern: Classify severity and authority needs.
five_stage.preserve: Retain triage and escalation evidence.

systems.purpose: Track operational wellbeing and workload health of PENTA workers/systems, maintenance stress, burnout-like capacity indicators and support needs without acting as clinical care.
systems.human_surface: Workload/wellbeing signals, support routing and capacity health views
systems.authority_boundary: This institutional subsystem is not a medical provider and does not diagnose or deliver clinical treatment; sensitive human data requires explicit policy and privacy controls.

five_stage.discover: Resolve operational wellbeing/capacity signals.
five_stage.govern: Apply privacy and support policy.
five_stage.verify: Confirm support disposition and workload state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain minimal governed wellbeing evidence.

systems.purpose: Govern worker/agent role records, onboarding/offboarding, contracts, classifications, performance process, access lifecycle and institutional workforce records.
systems.human_surface: Workforce roster, role, onboarding, access-lifecycle and policy views
systems.authority_boundary: HR records and workflows operate only within applicable human governance, privacy, legal and contractual authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve worker/role state and obligations.
five_stage.govern: Apply workforce, privacy and contract policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain governed workforce record lineage.

systems.purpose: Administer governed benefit eligibility, plans, entitlements, support programs and related workforce obligations.
systems.human_surface: Benefits eligibility, plan, enrollment, entitlement and support views
systems.authority_boundary: Benefits eligibility and entitlement require valid plan/legal/contract authority and cannot be manufactured by system state.

five_stage.discover: Resolve eligibility and plan state.
five_stage.govern: Apply benefit and legal policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain benefit decision and enrollment evidence.

systems.purpose: Govern compensation calculations, approved pay obligations, payout preparation and payment-provider reconciliation for authorized workers/agents.
systems.human_surface: Pay obligations, approvals, payout status, provider receipts and exceptions
systems.authority_boundary: No money movement occurs without explicit financial authority, approved pay obligation and certified payment rail.

five_stage.discover: Resolve approved compensation obligations.
five_stage.govern: Apply spend/payment/tax/legal controls.
five_stage.execute: Prepare or execute only authorized payouts.
five_stage.preserve: Retain pay evidence and audit lineage.

systems.purpose: Measure and govern PENTA operating cost, budgets, quotas, consumption, abuse prevention, unit economics and spend ceilings.
systems.human_surface: Cost, budget, quota, anomaly, unit-economics and abuse-control views
systems.authority_boundary: Cost optimization cannot authorize spend, deny legally required obligations, or manufacture budget authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve usage/cost/budget state.
five_stage.govern: Apply ceilings, quota and exception policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain budget and cost evidence.

systems.purpose: Represent governed board/directive intake, resolutions, delegated mandates, accountability and routing to subordinate PENTA governance lanes.
systems.human_surface: Board directives, resolutions, delegations, quorum/evidence and implementation tracking
systems.authority_boundary: Binding authority exists only from a valid CrownThrive governance instrument, role, quorum and scope; software cannot invent a board or resolution.

five_stage.discover: Resolve directives and governance context.
five_stage.govern: Verify quorum, scope and conflicts.
five_stage.execute: Route valid directives to accountable lanes.
five_stage.preserve: Retain resolutions and delegated-authority lineage.

systems.purpose: Orchestrate governed sanctions-screening requests, evidence, escalation and holds using authorized data/providers and legal policy.
systems.human_surface: Screening request, match confidence, evidence, legal escalation and hold views
systems.authority_boundary: PentaOFAC is an orchestration/compliance support subsystem, not OFAC or a legal determination authority; consequential disposition requires applicable legal/compliance authority.

five_stage.discover: Resolve screening subject/provider/data state.
five_stage.govern: Apply sanctions/legal/privacy policy.
five_stage.execute: Run authorized screening and route potential matches.
five_stage.verify: Validate provider evidence and review state.
five_stage.preserve: Retain screening evidence, holds and dispositions.

systems.purpose: Build bounded autonomous agent laboratories and capability suites only from approved PentaRFA requests, including TTL, tools, adapters, policy, rollback and job contract.
systems.human_surface: Agent suite build, lease/TTL, capability, restrictions and rollback views
systems.authority_boundary: PentaSuite can construct only the capabilities authorized by an approved RFA and cannot self-create an agent mandate.

five_stage.discover: Resolve approved RFA and job requirements.
five_stage.govern: Apply TTL, capability and risk limits.
five_stage.preserve: Retain suite version, lease and evidence lineage.

systems.purpose: Govern requests for new agents/capabilities, including job need, scope, TTL, authority, tools, constraints, approval/conditional approval/denial and reapplication lockout state.
systems.human_surface: RFA request, decision, conditions, TTL, appeal and lockout views
systems.authority_boundary: An RFA request is not authority; only a valid approval/conditional approval within governing policy can authorize PentaSuite construction.

five_stage.discover: Resolve job/capability need and alternatives.
five_stage.govern: Evaluate authority, cost, risk and TTL.
five_stage.preserve: Retain request, decision, lease and appeal lineage.

systems.purpose: Stack, tag, classify, nurture and govern pull-request lifecycle state so downstream merge and closer systems know dependencies, deadlines and dispositions.
systems.human_surface: PR topology, tags, dependencies, TTL, collision and lifecycle views
systems.authority_boundary: PR lifecycle metadata cannot approve or merge code by itself.

five_stage.discover: Resolve PR purpose, dependencies and collisions.
five_stage.govern: Apply labels, TTL, review and stacking policy.
five_stage.preserve: Retain PR lifecycle and supersession evidence.
